visualCharacteristics.purpose: intro panel beside a list of short benefits, each an icon + bold title + description
visualCharacteristics.layout: desktop: intro in the left third, benefits flowing column-first in two columns on the right; tablet: intro above two benefit columns; mobile: single column stack
visualCharacteristics.background: inherits the section style (blue section with white text on /service/plans)

contentPattern.structure: row 1: intro cell (H2 + paragraph), optional; then one row per benefit: one cell with a title paragraph (:check-circle: icon token + bold title) and a description paragraph

reuseGuidance: Use for a short list of icon + bold title + description benefits next to an intro. For linked tiles with images or icons use cards-grid; for numeric highlights use cards-stats.
